title: Named sessions lose source-root confirmation after every host restart until they re-name (named_root is not persisted or reconciled)
outcome: After a host restart, a session whose source root Engram still holds as Bound at the same generation opens its next turn confirmed, without the agent re-naming. Confirmation is restored by a persisted binding or a bounded canonical reconcile, with no unbounded RPC on the turn-opening path. A restart regression test proves it.
acceptance: Named sessions lose source-root confirmation after every host restart until they re-name (named_root is not persisted or reconciled) is done
